name: Supabase Free
free_limit: Free: 500 MB Postgres/project, 2 active projects, 50K monthly active users, 1 GB file storage and 5 GB egress
watch_out: Free projects pause after one week of inactivity. The 500 MB database is on shared CPU/500 MB RAM; the 5 GB cached egress is a separate quota. Daily backups and longer log retention require Pro. Paid add-ons/extra compute are not part of the $0 Free plan.
